description: USE WHEN you have a backtest result (Sharpe, trials tried, window) and want to know whether it is likely overfit. Given an annualized Sharpe, the number of configurations tried and the window (YYYY-MM-DD), returns the DEFLATED Sharpe (the expected maximum Sharpe by chance grows with the trial count: Bailey & Lopez de Prado), which CRISIS regimes the window never contained, and a base-rate caveat. An unknown trial count flags the Sharpe as not-deflatable / UNPROVEN. All inputs optional; give as many as known. Descriptive, not advisory.

annualized_sharpe.description: The claimed annualized Sharpe ratio of the backtest.
annualized_sharpe.title: Annualized Sharpe

asset.description: Asset context for the regime-coverage check (default: SPY as the equity-crisis reference).
asset.title: Asset

backtest_start.description: Backtest window start (YYYY-MM-DD) — used to detect crisis regimes the window never contained.
backtest_start.title: Backtest Start

frequency.description: Return observations per year (252 = daily bars).
frequency.title: Frequency

kurt.description: Kurtosis of the strategy's returns (3 = normal).
kurt.title: Kurt

n_trials.description: Number of configurations tried before selecting this backtest — drives the deflated-Sharpe correction. Unknown → the claim is flagged UNPROVEN.
n_trials.title: N Trials

skew.description: Skewness of the strategy's returns (0 = symmetric).
skew.title: Skew

name: backtest_integrity
title: Backtest integrity check (deflated Sharpe + regime coverage)
